landing.headline: Free public saunas on Lake Harku
landing.subheadline: Three wood-fired igloo saunas on the shore, run by the city. See how busy they are before you head out.
landing.liveIdle: Quiet right now — be the first to check in today
landing.howStep1Body: Open the map to see how busy each of the three saunas is right now.
landing.howStep2Title: Book a time — or just walk up
landing.howStep2Body: Reserve an hour ahead, or come by and join the live queue whenever a sauna is free.
landing.howStep3Title: Get the keys, confirm you're there
landing.howStep3Body: Collect the keys from the on-site guard with an ID document, then confirm your visit with a photo and your location.
landing.rulesIntro: The saunas are run by Haabersti District Government. These are the official rules for using them.
rules: Keys are handed out by the on-site guard against an ID document.
Use is first-come, first-served whenever a sauna is free.
One session lasts up to 3 hours.
Bring your own firewood: hardwood only, split to about 30 cm.
No smoking in or around the saunas.
Throw only clean water on the stones — never lake water.
Minors only together with an adult.
No alcohol, and no using the sauna while intoxicated.
Clean up after yourself — cleaning gear is in the yellow hut to the left of the changing cabins.
landing.galleryNote: Mood images, not photos of this exact site — we'll swap in real Lake Harku photos once the client provides them.
